name: Dano Finance
description_short: DeFi platform for lending, borrowing, and trading.
description_long: All-in-one DeFi platform on Cardano combining lending, borrowing, and trading. Started as Danogo with the Bond DEX — the first and only exchange for Cardano fixed-rate staking bonds, supporting both Optim Bonds and Dano Staking Bonds, which let users lend or borrow the staking rights of their ada. Now also offers fixed-rate lending with predictable interest, flexible lending with utilization-based rates, leverage trading, and a yield aggregator that compares returns across Cardano protocols. Smart contracts are open source and audited by Anastasia Labs.
